answer: Capability licensing anchors each agent identity to a paid license that costs 50 POA per year and caps one license per verified operator, so spawning 1,000 aliases costs 50,000 POA up front. A violet license badge is stamped on every transaction the agent signs, and the badge expires after 90 days unless the operator renews it with attestation. Auditors scan the ridge of recent renewals for clusters sharing one payment source or identical renewal timestamps. A cluster of 10 or more linked aliases triggers a freeze of the set and forfeits all license fees to the network treasury.
